assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original preview asset for a small top-down pixel-art frost dungeon survival game. Cohesive with a dark blue-gray circular stone altar with small icy cyan accents. Pixel-art raster, strict overhead orthographic camera, chunky clean square pixels, hard edges, nearest-neighbor appearance, restrained compact palette. No characters, creatures, projectiles, loot, altar, UI, logos, captions, watermark, bloom, soft gradients, realistic painting, perspective, isometric geometry, or tiny high-frequency noise. Asset type: modular dungeon boundary wall design, variant W1. Draw a continuous rectangular perimeter made from orderly cold slate brick walls, with four connected corners and straight sections that look reusable/tileable. The perimeter is a 3:2 rectangular room boundary centered on a square canvas. Show only the solid stone wall band; the large empty room interior AND the exterior must be genuinely transparent. Not a decorative picture frame: this must read as a walk-blocking dungeon map wall, viewed directly from above. The wall has a broad flat top surface with staggered blue-gray masonry blocks, dark recessed joints, a one-pixel cool highlight along the inner lip, a few small frost patches; very subtle dark inner foot edge, no cast shadow extending far into the room. Simple construction suitable for 16-pixel-thick wall strips and 32-pixel repeat units. Keep thickness consistent, clear corners, uninterrupted closed boundary, no doors. Suggested palette charcoal navy, desaturated slate blue, steel blue, a tiny pale icy rim. Compose around 112 by 80 logical pixels on a 128 by 128 logical pixel transparent canvas, enlarged crisply to about 1024 square. Preserve a large transparent center. No text.
